note: PAST/FUTURE/PERIOD are educational possibilities, not automatically derived proof. TENSE examples for STATE/MOVEMENT must be classed by grammatical structure and scene truth separately.

classificationLegend.SOURCE_SUPPORTED_REFERENCE: Sentence/structure is supported by an authored scene or established SIYAYO reference, still not new approved scoring.
classificationLegend.SOURCE_SUPPORTED_NON_TARGET_FUNCTION: Source phrase exists in corpus, but has the wrong function construction for this particular targeted grammar skill.
classificationLegend.CONTEXTUAL_RECONSTRUCTION: A plausible reformulation based on events in other scenes, not a canonical sourced sentence, requires review.
classificationLegend.PREDICTION_ONLY: Future statement expresses an uncertain forecast or plan, not an observed property or action; may be authored for a separate task.
classificationLegend.BLOCKED_MISSING_PREMISE: No phrase is automatically generated because prerequisite chronology, duration, facts or context are missing.
